note: Larkspur's planning numbers for a teaching simulator, not measurements of any real network, browser or server. Every wait the Opening a web page module shows comes from these, the customers and the page's file list.

words.trip: a round trip takes 10 ms to get onto the network, plus 2 ms for every 100 km there and back
words.server: 20 ms for the shop to build a reply
words.rto: a lost packet is sent again after a 1-second wait
words.h1: a browser speaking HTTP/1.1 opens up to 6 connections to one site
words.ticket: Larkspur's shop honours a returning browser's session ticket for a day
words.directory: the root's office is 150 km from every customer's resolver and the .example office 500 km; Larkspur's own directory office stands beside the shop
words.cold: a customer who has never visited starts with a resolver that remembers nothing; a returning customer's resolver still remembers the root's and .example's answers
